info.name: Ecommerce API – Full Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Ecommerce REST API.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:5000)

**Authentication**: Most endpoints require a Bearer token. After login/register, copy the token into the `authToken` collection variable. All authenticated folders inherit it automatically.

**Admin endpoints**: Require an admin-role JWT.

request.description: Returns API health status, timestamp, and service name.

item.name: Global Attribute Management
item.description: Master Attributes definition (e.g., RAM, Size, Spice Level)

item.name: Config & Banners
item.description: Public store configuration and home screen promotional carousels (zero frontend hardcoding).

request.description: Returns live store details, support WhatsApp/phone, shipping charges, free delivery threshold, payment toggles, first order offer, and referral rules.
Returns all active home screen promotional sliders and campaign banners sorted by sortOrder.
Returns all currently active and non-expired coupons available for customer cart and checkout discount drawers (code, discountType, discountValue, minOrderAmount, maxDiscount).

item.name: Get Legal Policies (Terms, Privacy, Returns, Shipping)

request.description: Returns full dynamic legal texts for Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Return & Refund Policy, and Shipping Policy (100% backend-managed by Admin).
Returns customer support FAQs categorized by topic (Orders, Payments, Returns, Referrals).
Returns structured size charts (columns, rows, units) for category apparel displayed in product detail screens.

Unified 100% backend-driven customer home screen feed containing announcementBar, brand theme tokens, hero carousels, category grid, featured products with variant matrix, active promotional offers, first-order discounts, customer reviews/testimonials, and store trust badges.
Returns dynamic dropdown reasons for order cancellations and product returns configured by the store admin.
Returns complete navigation tree including header tabs with promotional badges and footer multi-column links.
Returns primary, secondary, and accent brand colors, typography font families, border radiuses, and light/dark theme tokens.
Checks customer pincode delivery serviceability, estimated delivery days, and Cash on Delivery (COD) availability based on admin rules.
Sends a 6-digit OTP to the given phone number via WhatsApp.
Register a new user. OTP must be verified first via /send-otp. Optionally pass a referralCode. Auto-saves returned token.
Login with phone/email and password. Auto-saves returned token to authToken variable.
Login as Administrator (seeded: decodexfashionwear@gmail.com / Admin@12345). Auto-saves the returned token into both adminToken and authToken collection variables.
Get the authenticated user's profile details.
Update the authenticated user's profile name and email address. Validates email uniqueness.
Deactivate customer account. Blocks deletion if active/in-transit orders exist.

query.description: Filter by main catalog: men, women, kids, or all
Filter by status: active, inactive, or all (default: active)

Filter subcategories directly under parent slug (e.g. men, women, kids)
Filter by parent UUID, or 'null' for root categories only
Search category by name, description, or slug
Filter categories that have at least 1 product (true/false)
Sort order: sortOrder_asc, sortOrder_desc, name_asc, name_desc, products_desc, newest, oldest
Return nested tree structure with subCategories under parent categories

request.description:
List categories with comprehensive filtering:

• `mainSlug`: 'men' | 'women' | 'kids' | 'all'
• `status`: 'active' | 'inactive' | 'all'
• `level`: 1 (parents) | 2 (subcategories)
• `parentSlug`: 'men' | 'women' | 'kids'
• `parentId`: UUID or 'null'
• `search`: text search across name, description, slug
• `hasProducts`: true | false
• `sort`: 'sortOrder_asc' | 'name_asc' | 'products_desc' | 'newest'
• `tree`: true (nested hierarchy)
• `grouped`: true ({ all, men, women, kids })
• `page` & `limit`: pagination metadata
Get details for a specific category including its products.

query.description: Scope filters to specific category or subcategory slug

request.description:
Returns full, dynamic e-commerce catalog filter facets:

• `totalProducts`: Total matching active products
• `departments`: [{ name, slug, count }]
• `categories`: [{ id, name, slug, mainSlug, level, parent, productCount }]
• `categoryTree`: 3-level hierarchy with product counts
• `brands`: [{ name, count }]
• `sizes`: [{ size, count }]
• `colors`: [{ color, hex, count }]
• `fabrics`: [{ name, count }]
• `fits`: [{ name, count }]
• `sleeves`: [{ name, count }]
• `patterns`: [{ name, count }]
• `price`: { min, max, avg }
• `priceBuckets`: [{ label, min, max, count }]
• `sortOptions`: [{ label, value }]

query.description: Category slug (matches direct category, children, and grandchildren)
Filter by brand name (comma-separated for multi-brand)
Filter by fit: Slim, Regular, Oversized, etc.
Search by product name, description, brand

request.description: Get paginated products with full e-commerce filtering across categories, departments, brands, fabrics, fits, sleeves, patterns, sizes, colors, price ranges, in-stock status, and sorting.
Get full product details by ID or slug, including variants and images.
Get the current user's cart with items, variants, and totals.
Add a product variant to the cart. Quantity defaults to 1 if not specified.
Update the quantity of a specific cart item. Setting quantity to 0 removes the item.
Remove a specific item from the cart.
Remove all items from the cart.
Preview checkout calculation — returns item totals, applicable discounts, shipping cost, wallet deduction, and final payable amount. Send empty items array to use cart contents.
Place an order. paymentMethod can be 'CASHFREE' (online) or 'COD'. For Cashfree, a payment session URL is returned. useWallet: true applies wallet balance.
List all orders for the authenticated user.
Get detailed information for a specific order. Automatically verifies and synchronizes Cashfree payment status if pending.
Explicitly verify and synchronize payment status directly with Cashfree's API. Updates order to CONFIRMED and paymentStatus to SUCCESS upon verification.
Cancel an order (allowed only before shipping). Payments and wallet amounts are refunded automatically.
Public order payment verification endpoint used by frontend polling and return callbacks (does not require auth header).
Redirect target where Cashfree returns the user after modal/redirect payment.
Customer initiates a return request within 7 days of delivery.
Get the current wallet balance for the authenticated user.
Get the wallet transaction ledger (credits, debits, referrals, refunds, etc.).
Get the authenticated user's referral code, total earned, successful/pending referrals, and detailed referral list.
Public endpoint. Validate a referral code before registration. Returns validity status and referrer name.
Get all notifications for the authenticated user along with unread count.
Mark a specific notification as read.
Mark all notifications for the current user as read.
Delete a single notification by ID.
Delete all notifications for the current user.
Cashfree payment webhook endpoint. Protected by signature verification middleware. Normally called by Cashfree servers, not manually.
Instantly simulates a local Cashfree PAYMENT_SUCCESS webhook during testing. Automatically looks up order payment amount.

request.description: List all orders with optional status and payment status filters. Includes pagination, user info, order items, and payments.

Initiate a Cashfree refund for a paid order. Amount is optional — defaults to full payment amount. Order must have paymentStatus = SUCCESS.

Manually debit a customer's wallet. Fails if user does not have sufficient balance. Updates ledger.
Get all dynamic system settings (first order offer, referral program, shipping config, COD settings, etc.).
